label: prop:color-spacetime-s5-factorization
title: Color and spacetime are orthogonal $S_2\times S_3$ factors of the Bring Galois group $S_5$
html:
Proposition. Color and spacetime are orthogonal S_2\times S_3 factors of the Bring Galois group S_5

Let K be a Bring-embeddable knot evaluated through the categorical Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M on the Hecke algebra H_2(q) \oplus H_3(q), whose 2+3=5 irreducible representations constitute the Bring fivefold, with Bring's five homogeneous coordinates split as spacetime (x_0, x_1) and color (x_2, x_3, x_4). The substrate Galois group S_5 contains the block-diagonal product

  S_2 \times S_3 \hookrightarrow S_5.

Then:

  1. The factorization S_2 \times S_3 \hookrightarrow S_5 acts faithfully.
  2. The color factor S_3 fixes every spacetime coordinate. The spacetime factor S_2 fixes every color coordinate. The two sectors remain orthogonal.
  3. Every additive homomorphism from the connected phase parameter \mathbb{R} to a finite group is trivial.
